hook.name: EulrV4QuoteFriendlyTaxHook
hook.description: A buy/sell tax hook for token pools paired with a quote currency. Charges a fixed buy tax and a dynamic sell tax (ranging between configurable min/max BPS) that decreases as the token price rises above a sentiment baseline. Tax amounts are deducted from swap input via BeforeSwapDelta — sent to a tax recipient on buys, or burned via the token's hook contract on sells. Only exact-input swaps are supported.
